mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are at 31 degrees with a feels-like of 22 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park, all under a beautiful waxing crescent moon.

In city news, the Verona Plan Commission has several pending development projects on their upcoming agenda for December 7, including site plans for the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, official election notices for the 2026 cycles are now available for public review.

We have plenty of fun ahead, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Square, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, or see the John Denver tribute concert at the High School Fine Arts Center on November 15.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I after he was found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM for all your custard needs.
